## Setup

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import re
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import gaussian_kde
from IPython.display import display

pd.set_option("display.max_columns", 50)
pd.set_option("display.max_rows", 20)

# Find the digitalrodent folder
root = Path.cwd()
while root != root.parent:
    if (root / "data" / "MetaData").exists():
        break
    root = root.parent

meta_dir = root / "data" / "MetaData"
dr_dir = root / "results" / "dual_regression"
out_dir = root / "results" / "combined_simple"
fig_dir = root / "results" / "figures_simple"

out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
fig_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# Master list of the 20 datasets
datasets = pd.read_csv(root / "data" / "datasets.tsv", sep="\t", dtype=str)
datasets["dataset_id"] = datasets["dataset_id"].str.zfill(2)

display(datasets.fillna("NA"))
```

## Small functions for the merge

```{python}
def clean_name(text):
    text = str(text).strip().lower()
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "_", text)
    return text.strip("_")


def read_file(path):
    sep = "\t" if path.suffix.lower() == ".tsv" else ","
    df = pd.read_csv(path, sep=sep, dtype=str)
    df = df.dropna(axis=0, how="all").dropna(axis=1, how="all")
    df.columns = [clean_name(c) for c in df.columns]
    return df


def first_column(df, choices):
    for col in choices:
        if col in df.columns:
            return col
    return None


def clean_session(value):
    if pd.isna(value):
        return pd.NA
    text = str(value).strip()
    if text == "" or text.lower() in ["na", "nan", "none"]:
        return pd.NA
    match = re.search(r"ses[-_ ]?([a-z0-9]+)", text, re.I)
    if match:
        return "ses-" + match.group(1)
    if text.isdigit():
        return "ses-" + text
    return text


def clean_run(value):
    if pd.isna(value):
        return pd.NA
    text = str(value).strip()
    if text == "" or text.lower() in ["na", "nan", "none"]:
        return pd.NA
    match = re.search(r"run[-_ ]?([a-z0-9]+)", text, re.I)
    if match:
        return "run-" + match.group(1)
    if text.isdigit():
        return "run-" + text
    return text


def clean_participant(value, dataset_id):
    if pd.isna(value):
        return pd.NA

    text = str(value).strip()
    if text == "" or text.lower() in ["na", "nan", "none"]:
        return pd.NA

    # A few datasets use a different name in metadata and DR
    if dataset_id == "01":
        digits = re.sub(r"\D", "", text)
        return "sub-" + digits.zfill(7) if digits else pd.NA

    if dataset_id == "03":
        number = re.search(r"\d+", text)
        return f"sub-MFC{int(number.group()):03d}" if number else pd.NA

    if dataset_id in ["07", "08"]:
        text = re.sub(r"^sub-", "", text, flags=re.I)
        text = re.sub(r"^jgrAD", "", text, flags=re.I)
        return "sub-jgrAD" + text

    if not text.lower().startswith("sub-"):
        text = "sub-" + text

    return text
```

## Prepare metadata and DR files

```{python}
def prepare_metadata(df, dataset_id):
    df = df.copy()

    # Find participant column
    if dataset_id == "01" and "rodent_sub" in df.columns:
        participant_col = "rodent_sub"
    elif dataset_id == "03" and "mouse_id" in df.columns:
        participant_col = "mouse_id"
    else:
        participant_col = first_column(
            df,
            ["participant_id", "subject", "subject_id", "mouse_id", "rodent_sub", "animal_id"]
        )

    if participant_col is None:
        raise ValueError("No participant column found")

    df["participant_id"] = df[participant_col].apply(
        lambda x: clean_participant(x, dataset_id)
    )

    # Session
    session_col = first_column(df, ["session", "rodent_session"])
    if session_col:
        df["session"] = df[session_col].apply(clean_session)
    else:
        df["session"] = pd.NA

    # Douglas has session inside Mouse ID, e.g. '59 ses-2'
    if dataset_id == "03":
        session_from_id = df[participant_col].astype(str).str.extract(
            r"(ses[-_ ]?\d+)", expand=False
        )
        df["session"] = session_from_id.apply(clean_session).fillna("ses-1")

    # Run
    run_col = first_column(df, ["run", "rodent_run"])
    if run_col:
        df["run"] = df[run_col].apply(clean_run)
    else:
        df["run"] = pd.NA

    # Sex
    sex_col = first_column(df, ["sex", "gender", "rodent_sex"])
    if sex_col:
        df["sex_simple"] = df[sex_col].astype(str).str.lower().str[0]
        df.loc[~df["sex_simple"].isin(["m", "f"]), "sex_simple"] = pd.NA
    else:
        df["sex_simple"] = pd.NA

    # Age in weeks, but only when the unit is clear
    df["age_weeks"] = np.nan

    week_col = first_column(df, ["age_when_scanned_weeks", "age_at_scan_weeks", "age_weeks"])
    day_col = first_column(df, ["age_days"])
    dob_col = first_column(df, ["dob", "date_of_birth"])
    scan_col = first_column(df, ["experiment_date", "date_scanned", "scan_date", "acquisition_date"])

    if week_col:
        df["age_weeks"] = pd.to_numeric(df[week_col], errors="coerce")
    elif day_col:
        df["age_weeks"] = pd.to_numeric(df[day_col], errors="coerce") / 7
    elif dob_col and scan_col:
        dob = pd.to_datetime(df[dob_col], errors="coerce")
        scan = pd.to_datetime(df[scan_col], errors="coerce")
        df["age_weeks"] = (scan - dob).dt.days / 7

    return df


def prepare_dr(df, dataset_id):
    df = df.copy()

    if "subject" not in df.columns:
        raise ValueError("No subject column found in DR file")

    # Get participant, session and run from the DR subject name
    df["participant_id"] = df["subject"].str.split(r"_(?:ses|task|run|acq|echo)-", regex=True).str[0]
    df["participant_id"] = df["participant_id"].apply(
        lambda x: clean_participant(x, dataset_id)
    )

    df["session"] = df["subject"].str.extract(r"_(ses-[^_]+)", expand=False)
    df["session"] = df["session"].apply(clean_session)

    df["run"] = df["subject"].str.extract(r"_(run-[^_]+)", expand=False)
    df["run"] = df["run"].apply(clean_run)

    for col in [c for c in df.columns if c.startswith("comp")]:
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce")

    return df


def first_value(series):
    values = series.dropna()
    return values.iloc[0] if len(values) else pd.NA
```

## Merge each dataset

```{python}
all_datasets = []
status = []

for _, info in datasets.iterrows():
    dataset_id = info["dataset_id"]
    dataset_name = info["dataset_name"]

    # Find all files that start with this dataset number
    meta_files = sorted(meta_dir.glob(f"{int(dataset_id)}.*")) + sorted(meta_dir.glob(f"{dataset_id}*"))
    meta_files = list(dict.fromkeys([p for p in meta_files if p.suffix.lower() in [".csv", ".tsv"]]))
    dr_files = sorted(dr_dir.glob(f"{dataset_id}_DR.csv"))

    metadata = None
    dr = None

    # Read metadata
    if meta_files:
        meta_parts = []
        for file in meta_files:
            try:
                meta_parts.append(prepare_metadata(read_file(file), dataset_id))
            except Exception as e:
                print(dataset_id, file.name, "metadata error:", e)

        if meta_parts:
            metadata = pd.concat(meta_parts, ignore_index=True, sort=False)

    # Read DR
    if dr_files:
        dr_parts = [prepare_dr(read_file(file), dataset_id) for file in dr_files]
        dr = pd.concat(dr_parts, ignore_index=True, sort=False)

    # Merge as far as possible
    if metadata is not None and dr is not None:
        keys = ["participant_id"]

        if metadata["session"].notna().any() and dr["session"].notna().any():
            keys.append("session")
        if metadata["run"].notna().any() and dr["run"].notna().any():
            keys.append("run")

        # Prevent duplicate metadata rows from multiplying the DR rows
        other_cols = [c for c in metadata.columns if c not in keys]
        metadata = metadata.groupby(keys, dropna=False, as_index=False)[other_cols].agg(first_value)

        metadata["has_metadata"] = True
        dr["has_dr"] = True

        merged = dr.merge(metadata, on=keys, how="outer", suffixes=("", "_meta"))

    elif metadata is not None:
        merged = metadata.copy()
        merged["has_metadata"] = True
        merged["has_dr"] = False

    elif dr is not None:
        merged = dr.copy()
        merged["has_metadata"] = False
        merged["has_dr"] = True

    else:
        merged = pd.DataFrame({
            "participant_id": [pd.NA],
            "has_metadata": [False],
            "has_dr": [False]
        })

    if "has_metadata" not in merged.columns:
        merged["has_metadata"] = False
    if "has_dr" not in merged.columns:
        merged["has_dr"] = False

    merged["has_metadata"] = merged["has_metadata"].fillna(False).astype(bool)
    merged["has_dr"] = merged["has_dr"].fillna(False).astype(bool)

    merged.insert(0, "dataset_name", dataset_name)
    merged.insert(0, "dataset_id", dataset_id)

    # Save every dataset separately
    merged.to_csv(
        out_dir / f"{dataset_id}_merged.csv",
        index=False,
        na_rep="NA"
    )

    all_datasets.append(merged)

    status.append({
        "dataset_id": dataset_id,
        "dataset_name": dataset_name,
        "metadata": "yes" if metadata is not None else "no",
        "DR": "yes" if dr is not None else "no",
        "rows": len(merged)
    })

    print("\n", dataset_id, "-", dataset_name, "| rows:", len(merged))
    display(merged.fillna("NA"))
```

## Number of subjects

```{python}
with_dr = combined[combined["has_dr"] & combined["participant_id"].notna()].copy()

subject_counts = (
    with_dr.drop_duplicates(["dataset_id", "participant_id", "session"])
    .groupby("dataset_name")
    .size()
    .sort_values()
)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, max(5, len(subject_counts) * 0.4)))
```

```{python}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# AGE DISTRIBUTION ACROSS ALL DATASETS
# One figure, one shared x-axis
# Each dataset = one row
# Half violin + boxplot + sample size
# ---------------------------------------------------------

plot_data = combined[
    combined["has_dr"]
    & combined["participant_id"].notna()
    & combined["age_weeks"].notna()
].copy()


# Make sure age is numeric
plot_data["age_weeks"] = pd.to_numeric(
    plot_data["age_weeks"],
    errors="coerce"
)

plot_data = plot_data.dropna(subset=["age_weeks"])


# Keep one row per subject/session
plot_data = plot_data.drop_duplicates(
    ["dataset_id", "participant_id", "session"]
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# ORDER DATASETS
# Here they are ordered by median age
# ---------------------------------------------------------

dataset_order = (
    plot_data
    .groupby("dataset_name")["age_weeks"]
    .median()
    .sort_values()
    .index
    .tolist()
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# CREATE ONE FIGURE
# ---------------------------------------------------------

fig, ax = plt.subplots(
    figsize=(12, max(6, len(dataset_order) * 0.55))
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# DRAW ALL DATASETS ON THE SAME AXIS
# ---------------------------------------------------------

for i, dataset in enumerate(dataset_order):

    ages = (
        plot_data.loc[
            plot_data["dataset_name"] == dataset,
            "age_weeks"
        ]
        .dropna()
        .astype(float)
        .values
    )

    if len(ages) == 0:
        continue

    y = i


    # -----------------------------------------------------
    # HALF VIOLIN
    # -----------------------------------------------------

    if len(ages) >= 2 and len(np.unique(ages)) > 1:

        kde = gaussian_kde(ages)

        x_grid = np.linspace(
            ages.min(),
            ages.max(),
            300
        )

        density = kde(x_grid)

        # Same maximum height for each dataset
        density = density / density.max() * 0.30

        # Half violin above the boxplot
        ax.fill_between(
            x_grid,
            y,
            y - density,
            alpha=0.40
        )

        ax.plot(
            x_grid,
            y - density,
            linewidth=1
        )


    # -----------------------------------------------------
    # BOXPLOT
    # -----------------------------------------------------

    box = ax.boxplot(
        ages,
        vert=False,
        positions=[y + 0.10],
        widths=0.18,
        showfliers=False,
        patch_artist=True,
        manage_ticks=False
    )

    for patch in box["boxes"]:
        patch.set(
            facecolor="white",
            linewidth=1.2
        )

    for median in box["medians"]:
        median.set(
            linewidth=1.8
        )

    for whisker in box["whiskers"]:
        whisker.set(
            linewidth=1
        )

    for cap in box["caps"]:
        cap.set(
            linewidth=1
        )


    # -----------------------------------------------------
    # SAMPLE SIZE
    # -----------------------------------------------------

    ax.text(
        ages.max() + 0.5,
        y + 0.10,
        f"n = {len(ages)}",
        va="center",
        ha="left",
        fontsize=9
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# AXIS LABELS
# ---------------------------------------------------------

ax.set_yticks(range(len(dataset_order)))
ax.set_yticklabels(dataset_order)

ax.set_xlabel("Age (weeks)")
ax.set_ylabel("")

ax.set_title(
    "Age distribution across all datasets",
    loc="left",
    fontweight="bold"
)


# Youngest median age at the top
ax.invert_yaxis()


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# CLEAN FIGURE STYLE
# ---------------------------------------------------------

ax.grid(
    axis="x",
    alpha=0.15
)

ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
ax.spines["left"].set_visible(False)

ax.tick_params(
    axis="y",
    length=0
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# EXTRA SPACE FOR n = ...
# ---------------------------------------------------------

min_age = plot_data["age_weeks"].min()
max_age = plot_data["age_weeks"].max()

age_range = max_age - min_age

if age_range == 0:
    age_range = 1

ax.set_xlim(
    min_age - age_range * 0.03,
    max_age + age_range * 0.20
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# SAVE + SHOW
# ---------------------------------------------------------

plt.tight_layout()

plt.savefig(
    fig_dir / "01_age_distribution_all_datasets.png",
    dpi=300,
    bbox_inches="tight"
)

plt.show()
```

## DR inclusion

```{python}
metadata_rows = combined[
    combined["has_metadata"] & combined["participant_id"].notna()
].copy()

if len(metadata_rows):
    inclusion = (
        metadata_rows.groupby(["dataset_name", "participant_id", "session"], dropna=False)["has_dr"]
        .max()
        .reset_index()
    )

    inclusion["status"] = np.where(inclusion["has_dr"], "With DR", "No DR")

    inclusion_counts = (
        inclusion.groupby(["dataset_name", "status"])
        .size()
        .unstack(fill_value=0)
    )

    for col in ["With DR", "No DR"]:
        if col not in inclusion_counts.columns:
            inclusion_counts[col] = 0

    inclusion_counts = inclusion_counts[["With DR", "No DR"]]
    inclusion_counts = inclusion_counts.loc[inclusion_counts.sum(axis=1).sort_values().index]

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, max(5, len(inclusion_counts) * 0.4)))
    left = np.zeros(len(inclusion_counts))

    for col in ["With DR", "No DR"]:
        ax.barh(inclusion_counts.index, inclusion_counts[col], left=left, label=col)
        left += inclusion_counts[col].values

    ax.set_title("DR inclusion")
    ax.set_xlabel("Subjects / scans")
    ax.set_ylabel("")
    ax.legend(frameon=False)
    ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(fig_dir / "02_DR_inclusion.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.show()
```

## Sex

```{python}
sex_data = combined[
    combined["has_metadata"] & combined["participant_id"].notna()
].copy()

sex_data = sex_data.drop_duplicates(["dataset_id", "participant_id", "session"])
sex_data = sex_data[sex_data["sex_simple"].isin(["m", "f"])]

if len(sex_data):

        sex_data.groupby(["dataset_name", "sex_simple"])
```

## DR heatmap

```{python}
components = [f"comp{i}" for i in range(1, 19) if f"comp{i}" in combined.columns]

dr_data = combined[combined["has_dr"]].copy()

for col in components:
    dr_data[col] = pd.to_numeric(dr_data[col], errors="coerce")

if components and len(dr_data):
    heatmap = dr_data.groupby("dataset_name")[components].median()

    # Standardize each row so the component pattern is easier to compare
    heatmap = heatmap.sub(heatmap.mean(axis=1), axis=0)
    heatmap = heatmap.div(heatmap.std(axis=1).replace(0, np.nan), axis=0)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, max(5, len(heatmap) * 0.4)))
    image = ax.imshow(heatmap.values, aspect="auto")

    ax.set_yticks(range(len(heatmap)))
    ax.set_yticklabels(heatmap.index)
    ax.set_xticks(range(len(components)))
    ax.set_xticklabels(components, rotation=45, ha="right")
    ax.set_title("DR heatmap")
    ax.set_xlabel("Component")
    ax.set_ylabel("")
    plt.colorbar(image, ax=ax, label="z-score")
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(fig_dir / "05_DR_heatmap.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.show()
```

## Component ridgelines

```{python}

for component in [f"comp{i}" for i in range(1, 19)]:

    if f"{component}" in dr_data.columns:
        comp_data = dr_data[["dataset_name", component]].dropna()
        counts = comp_data.groupby("dataset_name").size()
        groups = counts[counts >= 3].index.tolist()

        if groups:
            x_min = comp_data[component].min()
            x_max = comp_data[component].max()
            x = np.linspace(x_min, x_max, 400)

            fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, max(5, len(groups) * 0.55)))

            for i, group in enumerate(groups):
                values = comp_data.loc[comp_data["dataset_name"] == group, component].values

                if len(np.unique(values)) > 1:
                    density = gaussian_kde(values)(x)
                    density = density / density.max()
                    ax.fill_between(x, i, i + density * 0.8, alpha=0.6)
                    ax.plot(x, i + density * 0.8, linewidth=1)

                ax.scatter(values, np.full(len(values), i), marker="|", s=35)

            ax.set_yticks(range(len(groups)))
            ax.set_yticklabels(groups)
            ax.set_title(f"Component {component} by dataset")
            ax.set_xlabel("DR value")
            ax.set_ylabel("")
            ax.spines[["top", "right", "left"]].set_visible(False)
            plt.tight_layout()
            plt.savefig(fig_dir / f"06_component{component}_ridgeline.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
            plt.show()
```
